findings.title: CARD tranche has terminal_id=null because zero ACTIVE PaymentTerminal rows exist (selectedTerminalId=null, paymentTerminals=[])
findings.evidence: Live introspection: tranches[1].terminal_id = undefined. selectedTerminalId = null. paymentTerminals.length = 0.
findings.code_path: PaymentComponent.vue:660-664 auto-attach only fires if `this.selectedTerminalId` is truthy AND mode flips via updateTranche. Backend PosOrderRequest:114-119 (referenced in heal comment) rejects 422 'A valid payment terminal is required for every CARD tranche.'
findings.user_impact: If a cashier with no TPE configured tries 3-tranche cash+card+TR, the UI shows canConfirmMulti=true (green path) but submit will 422. UX trap: the canConfirmCard gate (line 449-452) only protects the legacy single-tender CARD path, not the multi-tender CARD-tranche path.
findings.recommendation: Tighten canConfirmMulti to also require selectedTerminalId>0 if any tranche has mode=CARD. V1.0.x backlog already mentions per-tranche terminal dropdown.

findings.title: When overpaying via amount allocation, the 'Reste dû' row shows '0.00€' with `--ok` (green) class even though the cashier has over-allocated 2€
findings.evidence: PaymentComponent.vue:432-434 `remainingDueEur` computed = `cents > 0 ? splitFromCents(cents) : 0` → clamped at 0. There is NO change-row visible because totalChangeCents only sums cash-mode tendered overflow, not amount overflow. Cashier sees: green 'Reste dû 0€', green 'Couvert 32€', but greyed-out confirm button — root cause invisible.
findings.user_impact: Cashier confusion: 'why is the button greyed when remaining is 0?' Could lead to repeated retry clicks or workaround attempts.
findings.recommendation: Add a 'Surpayé X€' row (red/orange) when sumCovered > totalCents AND overflow > 100c, OR change remaining-row class to `--invalid` when canConfirmMulti=false. V1.0.2 backlog item.
